# Card Resource

## Summary
The wire shape of a card instance is a JSON:API resource:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "type": "card",
    "attributes": { "…field values…": "…" },
    "relationships": { "…linksTo fields…": {} },
    "meta": { "adoptsFrom": { "module": "…", "name": "…" } }
  }
}
```

## Invariants
- `type` is always `"card"`.
- Contained field values live in `attributes`; linked cards only in
  `relationships`.
- `meta.adoptsFrom` is required and must resolve (see Adopts From Metadata).
- Realms re-serialize on save: UTF-8 (no unicode escapes), no trailing
  newline — byte-identical round-trips are not guaranteed, semantic
  round-trips are.

## Example
The account card (`Account/acme-industries`) demonstrates this: its
attributes carry name, email, and billing address values, and its
`meta.adoptsFrom` points at `../account`.

## Module
`runtime-common/card-document-shape.ts` — resource shape; serialization
entry point: `https://cardstack.com/base/card-api` — export
`serializeForUI`.
